# laravelforge_site_laravel_scheduler (Resource)

Manages the Laravel scheduler integration on a Laravel Forge site. Enabling/disabling has no update path, so changes recreate the resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the site belongs to.
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the site the integration belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the Laravel scheduler integration is enabled.
- `laravel_installed` (String) Whether Laravel is installed on the site.
